title: Slicing an integer multiplicity current with integer multiplicity boundary by a Lipschitz function (Simon 6.4.1–4.5, 4.8)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ with m + 1 < P. Let T ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P) be represented by an integer multiplicity triple R_T = (M, θ, ξ) (IMRep univ (m + 2), R_T.Represents T), and let ∂T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) be represented by an integer multiplicity triple R_∂ = (M', θ', ξ') (IMRep univ (m + 1)). Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be Lipschitz with constant L ∈ [0, ∞) (LipschitzWith L f). Then there are currents P_t ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) (t ∈ ℝ) such that: (1) for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P the function t ↦ M_W(P_t) ∈ [0, ∞] is a.e.-measurable for Lebesgue measure and ∫_ℝ M_W(P_t) dt ≤ L·M_W(T); (2) for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ: P_t is integer multiplicity; P_t(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(ℝ^P) whose topological support is disjoint from f⁻¹(t); and P_t(ω) = ∫_{M∩{f<t}} θ⟨dω, ξ⟩ dH^{m+2} − ∫_{M'∩{f<t}} θ'⟨ω, ξ'⟩ dH^{m+1} for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(ℝ^P) (Hᵏ = μHE[k]). The last identity says P_t = ∂(T⌞{f < t}) − (∂T)⌞{f < t}, Simon's formula 4.5(2) for the slice ⟨T, f, t⟩.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (RT : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (RB : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), m + 1 < P → RT.Represents T → RB.Represents T.boundary → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ Ps : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → AEMeasurable (fun t => (Ps t).massOn W) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (Ps t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * T.massOn W) ∧ ∀ᵐ t, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ps t) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) (f ⁻¹' {t}) → Ps t ω = 0) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Ps t ω = (∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 2]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]
